title: AI Lifecycle Security Wiki and AI Secure by Design
description: This content announces the creation of an AI Security Wiki and an AI Secure by Design project, which provide a comprehensive, vendor-neutral resource for AI security governance, risk management, architecture, standards, and compliance. The authors emphasize that many recent AI-related security incidents stem from failures in fundamental security practices rather than AI technology itself. The projects aim to help organizations integrate security fundamentals into AI development and deployment to mitigate risks associated with AI-assisted attacks.

aiSummary: The AI Security Wiki and AI Secure by Design projects are community-driven initiatives hosted on GitHub that compile knowledge and best practices for securing AI systems throughout their lifecycle. They cover topics such as AI governance, risk management, security controls, compliance with various international AI regulations, and role-based playbooks. The authors highlight that despite rapid technological changes and AI adoption, security fundamentals remain critical and often neglected, leading to security failures. These resources are intended to reinforce foundational security principles in AI development and help organizations manage AI-related risks effectively.
aiImpact: The impact is primarily educational and preventative, aiming to reduce AI-related security incidents by promoting adherence to established security fundamentals within AI projects. There is no direct vulnerability or exploit described. Instead, the projects address the broader risk landscape of AI security and governance, helping organizations avoid failures that could lead to breaches or misuse of AI technologies.
